hooks.command: [ -n "$(git status --porcelain -- app components lib supabase tests middleware.ts next.config.ts instrumentation.ts 2>/dev/null)" ] && echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"Obsidian vault sync pending — code changed this session. Log it to Plans/ChemMemo_Implementation_Plan.md and update ChemMemo.md frontmatter (skill: obsidian-vault-sync).\"}" || echo "{\"suppressOutput\":true}"

grep -qiE '"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*lib[\/]+database\.types\.ts"' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"lib/database.types.ts is generated from the linked Supabase project. Hand-editing it causes the schema drift it exists to prevent. Run `npm run types:gen` instead."}}' || echo '{"suppressOutput":true}'

grep -qiE '"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*supabase[\/]+migrations[\/]+[^"]*\.sql"' && echo '{"systemMessage":"Migration touched — run `npm run types:gen` before relying on lib/database.types.ts. Skipping it turns a renamed column into silent drift instead of a type error."}' || echo '{"suppressOutput":true}'
